scope: Six exact supporting targets for guarded descent with arbitrary binary original Program leaves R,V at [value,parameter]. Internal stabilization measures value, not carried state; original value tags and the identical symbolic parameter are retained.
independent_specification_review: Coordinator reported static review ACCEPT for all six unchanged targets before comparator preflight and proof authorship.
independent_postproof_review: Pending independent review of this completed packet.
freeze_history_note: FROZEN-SPECIFICATION, STATIC-CHECKS and SOURCE-CORRESPONDENCE preserve their pre-proof chronology. Their pending-work statements are superseded by this acceptance evidence without changing any frozen bytes or targets.
current_source_receipt_basis: Every current local source matches a successful module row by SHA256 in an immutable numeric native receipt and its hashed log, under the unchanged resource profile. Successful supplier rows remain usable when a later module in the same supplier run failed. Both new checker runs passed completely.
existing_supplier_warnings: Existing supplier warnings are retained unchanged; source-matched native logs and full warning module lists remain in local closure evidence.
binary_ast_selection: R,V : Program 2 precede the variable type, context and every symbolic term. Both literal AST constructors depend only on R,V, not on the positive operator body or context; targets quantify body before R,V. No symbolic parameter is compiled into a unary specialized AST.
actual_transition: candidate = R[value,parameter]; accept exactly when candidate < value AND V[candidate,parameter] = 1 AND original left(candidate) = original left(value); return candidate on acceptance and value otherwise.
internal_induction: Original full-language PA induction on symbolic fuel, using a finite universal row binding [input,out,typ,parameter]. Actual parameterized front-successor and fixed-point laws handle the first-step split while preserving the same parameter. Internal strict descent reduces the value bound, never the encoded pair bound.
zero_fuel: The row includes fuel zero with arbitrary nonzero parameter: repeatP returns the value, value <= 0 gives value = 0, and strict candidate < 0 rejection derives T(0,parameter)=0 independently of the carried pair.
original_tag_boundary: The preserved graph is InternalUnpair.left typ [value]. It is not left(pair(parameter,value)); source type tag and runtime parameter remain independent.

parameterized_iteration_supplier.status: Independently reviewed ACCEPT before descent proof authorship. Its actual internal laws, not its separate external evaluation calibration, are used.
parameterized_iteration_supplier.source_pinning: The initial frozen pins retain only its stable specifications/preflight; final CLOSURE-SOURCE-PINS also fixes its accepted current proof dependencies.
